☁️ Google Drive Help
Sign-in popup blocked?
Allow popups for this site in Chrome → Settings → Privacy → Site Settings → Pop-ups
Token expired?
Sign out and sign in again. Google tokens expire after 1 hour.
Drive API not enabled?
Go to console.cloud.google.com → APIs → Enable "Google Drive API"
Wrong Client ID?
Tap "Change Google Client ID" below to re-enter your credentials.
☁️ Google Drive Setup
📋 Get your Google Client ID (5 min, free)
1. Go to console.cloud.google.com
2. Create a project → any name
3. APIs & Services → Enable APIs → search Google Drive API → Enable
4. APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen → External → Fill app name + email → Save
5. APIs & Services → Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth Client ID
6. Application type: Web application
7. Authorised JavaScript origins: add your GitHub Pages URL e.g. https://yourname.github.io
8. Click Create → copy the Client ID below

📋 Build History
22
v22 — 30 Jun 2026 LATEST
📊 Expense Trend day-view income fix — Today tab now shows income per category alongside expense (was always 0)
🗂️ Category Breakdown is now tappable — tap a category to expand its transactions for the month, newest first
🛠️ Service worker cache fix — SW referenced an undefined cache name, which could silently fail to activate and leave the app stuck on an old cached build/version
21
v21 — 07 Jun 2026
⚠️ Live budget warning on Add Transaction — inline banner appears as you pick a category and type an amount; shows 📋 not in budget, ⚠️ 80%+ used, or 🚨 will exceed with exact overage
✏️ Budget warning on Edit Transaction — same live banner in the edit modal; correctly excludes the transaction's own original amount to avoid false over-budget alerts
🔄 Recurring amount currency fix — "Add as recurring" from new transaction now stores INR base amount; previously stored display-currency causing double-conversion for non-INR users
📅 Yearly recurring month fix — yearly recurrences were hardcoded to fire only in January; now correctly stores and checks the month the recurring was created in
📷 Receipt scan amount fix — scanned receipt amounts now correctly normalised to INR base before saving
🗑️ Delete transaction UX fix — edit modal now stays open until the user confirms deletion; cancelling the confirm no longer dismisses the modal
20
v20 — 06 Jun 2026
💰 Running account balance on every transaction — History page now shows the account balance after each transaction as a coloured pill, making it easy to track how each entry affects your account in real time
🆘 Emergency Fund redesigned — Account dropdown, tip card, Transfer & History tabs, larger arc gauge
🧓 Retirement Planner fixed — Page renders on open
🎨 Themes streamlined — 4 themes in one compact row; Aurora & Forest removed
🎯 Allocation Targets toggle — Enable/disable switch; OFF by default; asset & AI warnings suppressed when OFF
📊 Home chart simplified — Bar removed; Line & Area only
🔢 Debt Payoff month fix — 0% interest + 12-month tenure correctly shows 12 months; EMI auto-calc works at 0% rate
🔔 Bills overdue fix — Overdue now uses real date arithmetic (not just day-of-month); paid status auto-resets each new month
19
v19 — 03 May 2026
⚡ Bulk Hide / Show All — one-tap Hide All / Show All per group in Expense, Income, Platforms & Pay Methods customise lists
18
v18 — 03 May 2026
🏷️ Cashback icon fixed — Cashback now correctly shows 🏷️ tag icon; stale saved icons auto-cleared on load
🗑️ Delete built-in items — Built-in income sources, categories, platforms & pay methods can now be hidden
📋 Build history corrected — Duplicate v15 removed, dates & version numbers fixed
17
v17 — 05 Apr 2026
💰 Opening balance → Money In — Cash/Savings added in Accounts now shows in Money In
↩️ Carry forward fixed — opening balances flow into next month automatically
🏦 History account filter — compact dropdown with investment expense categories
16
v16 — 04 Apr 2026
🛡️ Drive sync fixed — PATCH existing file, never delete before upload
🔒 Auto-lock on background — screen lock triggers when app comes to foreground
🔢 Allocation % fix — stale alloc no longer triggers incorrect warnings
